title: DevSecOps Delivery & Verified Rollback
subtitle: Build once, inspect the selected artifact, promote the same bytes.
scenario: An operational application had several deployment targets and security scanners. A green build alone did not establish which source, package and container digest would reach production or what could be restored after a bad release.
outcome: Make releases traceable and recovery deliberate, with fewer rebuild differences and clear failure evidence before publication.
flow: Record source, digest and policy evidence
Restore a verified prior release if needed
notes: The local receipt is a trusted test fixture, not a signed scanner attestation.
This reference proves artifact/policy mechanics locally. Azure publication and original-build image provenance require separate acceptance.
Source findings, container findings and live configuration findings are tracked separately; remaining findings are not silently suppressed.
boundary: Sanitized patterns from an operational platform; this screen shows local code with fictional records.
